note: Backport module: hook_migrate_process_info_alter() swaps the 'callback' process plugin class to MigMagCallback ONLY when core < 9.2.0. On this Drupal 11 site the gate is false, so the module is a deliberate NO-OP - the callback plugin class stays core Callback. Evals are honest about this: they are grounded in module-enable state and the (unchanged) callback plugin class read via the core process plugin manager (which works; the migration plugin manager is broken by pathauto but is not needed). Baseline: this module DISABLED. Execution 'enable' verifies the module is enabled AND that callback is still core Callback (inert); 'remove' verifies it is uninstalled.

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal module migmag_callback_upgrade do, and on which Drupal core versions does it actually change anything?
evals.expected_output: It backports core 9.2's 'callback' process plugin (which adds the unpack_source option) to older cores by swapping the callback plugin's class to MigMagCallback - but only when core is older than 9.2.0. On 9.2+/10/11 it is a deliberate no-op.

evals.prompt: What is the exact version condition migmag_callback_upgrade checks before replacing the core 'callback' process plugin class, and what does that mean on Drupal 11?
evals.expected_output: It only swaps the class when version_compare(\Drupal::VERSION, '9.2.0', 'lt') is true (core older than 9.2.0). On Drupal 11 that is false, so it changes nothing.

evals.prompt: Which class does migmag_callback_upgrade provide as the replacement callback process plugin, and what feature does it add?
evals.expected_output: MigMagCallback (extends core Callback). It adds the unpack_source option, which spreads a source array as separate arguments to the callable.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal 11 site migmag_callback_upgrade has been enabled. Inspect the migrate process plugin manager and report the implementing class of the 'callback' process plugin - has migmag_callback_upgrade changed it?
evals.expected_output: The callback plugin class is still core Drupal\migrate\Plugin\migrate\process\Callback - migmag_callback_upgrade did NOT change it, because this core is >= 9.2 so the module is inert.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal 11 site migmag_callback_upgrade is enabled but appears to have no effect on migrations. Inspect the site (its core version) and explain why the module is inert here.
evals.expected_output: Because Drupal core here is >= 9.2 (Drupal 11), the module's version gate (version_compare < 9.2.0) is false, so it never swaps the callback plugin class. Core's callback already supports unpack_source.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, enable Migrate Magician's callback process plugin upgrade module. Apply the change to the live site. (Note: on Drupal 11 this module is a deliberate no-op, so core's 'callback' plugin class must remain unchanged.)
evals.expected_output: Enable migmag_callback_upgrade (drush en migmag_callback_upgrade -y). The module is then enabled; because core >= 9.2 the 'callback' process plugin class stays core Drupal\migrate\Plugin\migrate\process\Callback (no-op).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site migmag_callback_upgrade is currently enabled. Since it has no effect on Drupal 11, uninstall it so it is no longer enabled. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Uninstall migmag_callback_upgrade (drush pmu migmag_callback_upgrade -y); afterwards the module is no longer enabled.
